# scribl -- status

> **This page tracks the POC, not the production rebuild.** The two are separate
> layers of the engagement. The POC is the clickable prototype in the `scribl-app`
> repository, tracked by the M-numbered milestones and S-numbered stories below.
> The production rebuild, which is what the eight-week delivery is, is planned in
> [Backlog: epics and features](/backlog-epics) and
> [Client priority to delivery week](/client-priority-to-delivery-week), and is
> run on the SCRIBL Jira board. Do not read this page as the delivery plan.

**Overall status:** the POC has served its purpose and is in maintenance. The
production rebuild is in its Shape window.

The POC shipped its daily loop -- prompt-of-the-day, draw, write, speak,
submit-to-unlock, channel wall and reactions, streak -- then the full screen and
navigation buildout, and is deployed to a hosted web preview. It was walked with
the client at the 2026-08-25 prioritization workshop, and the change requests
from that session are recorded in `tracking/eric-poc-change-requests-2026-08-25.md`,
which is repo-only, and were being implemented through 2026-08-27. Rob Forshier II reported at the 2026-08-28
standup that he is hands-off on the prototype from that point except for bugs
and new designs, and moved to laying down the production harness.

What the POC does **not** do is seed production code. The production build is a
greenfield rebuild; the POC is reference for the four seams it proved, and
nothing is ported from it. See
[the decision register](/handbook/engineering/decision-register) entry 1.1.
